account.title: Sign in
account.description: Sign in with your Monster Smart Lighting app account.

data_description.local_control: Control the bulbs directly on your LAN (fast, works offline). The Monster app can't hold a local session at the same time; falls back to the cloud automatically.

onboard.title: Set up a new strip over Bluetooth
onboard.description: Put the strip into pairing mode and keep it near a Home Assistant Bluetooth adapter. Home Assistant will send it your Wi-Fi credentials over Bluetooth, then claim it to your account.

data_description.ssid: The 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network the strip should join.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Monster/Ayla servers.
error.regtoken_not_found: The strip joined Wi-Fi but couldn't be found on the network to finish claiming it. Make sure Home Assistant is on the same network.
error.onboard_failed: Bluetooth onboarding failed. Make sure the strip is in pairing mode and close to a Bluetooth adapter, then try again.

abort.no_strip_found: No strip found in pairing mode. Put the strip into setup mode and try again.
abort.device_added: The new strip was set up and added to your account.

progress.provisioning: Setting up over Bluetooth — pairing and sending Wi-Fi credentials. The strip can take a minute or two to join.
progress.claiming: Finding the strip on your network and claiming it to your account…
